'''Sersae Jenreal''' was a social analyst in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Later in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], she ran an exposé on Cularin's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren]] looking at whether she was actually related to [[Reidi Artom]], her influence in the Senate, and the relationship between her administration and the [[Almas Academy]].
